category.label: Ultrasonic Microphones
category.description: Wide-band condenser microphones (typ. 10–250 kHz) for rodent ultrasonic vocalization (USV) and bat/insect bioacoustics.

parameters.name: Sampling rate
parameters.notes: Nyquist must exceed highest USV harmonic (>100 kHz).

parameters.name: SNR
parameters.notes: Cage noise dominates; use directional array.

pitfalls.mitigation: Verify anti-alias filter and true fs ≥ 250 kHz

pitfalls.issue: Cage rattle spectrally overlaps 22 kHz calls

references.title: DeepSqueak: detection and analysis of ultrasonic vocalizations
